name: maintenance
description: Maintenance utilities: disk cleanup, log rotation and the maintenance scheduler.
author: nself
notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: no port, no HTTP server, no database tables. `nself plugin install maintenance` places the built nself-maintenance binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/, where ProxyCommand execs it for `nself maintenance <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from the CLI core under CLI-R11. internal/maintenance stays in the CLI too, because doctor and deploy use it.
